DigitalPassTmplParameter.name: DigitalPassTmplParameter
DigitalPassTmplParameter.description: Represents a specific, configurable data field within a digital pass template. It defines the content type such as text, date, or image, and properties such as label and visibility, for a particular section of the pass.

DataType.description: Required. The data type of the digital pass template attribute.

DefaultValue.description: The default value of the digital pass template attribute.

DigitalPassTemplateId.description: Required. The ID of the digital pass template.

IsRequired.description: Indicates whether the didgital pass template attribute is required (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: Required. The name of the digital pass template parameter.
